Artigo científico · 2025

Microstructural, mechanical, and acoustic analyses of concrete with EPS and silica fume

Silva, V. G. S.; Sandes Filho, C. G.; Angelin, A. F. P.; Paiva, R. E. M.; Palma, S. S. A.; Gonçalves, R.; Lintz, R. C. C.; Gachet, L. A.; Miranda Jr., E. J. P.

Revista de Estruturas e Materiais · v. 18 · e18112

Ver publicação ↗

Abstract

This article examines the microstructural, mechanical and acoustic behaviour of concrete incorporating expanded polystyrene and silica fume. The combined analysis relates material composition and internal structure to the resulting physical, mechanical and acoustic properties, supporting the development of lighter and multifunctional cementitious materials.
